notes: Adding a debt now only needs the balance and the APR. The name is optional (it falls back to the account type), and if you leave the minimum payment blank we estimate it for you — you can always edit it afterwards.
If something is missing, the form now tells you which field and highlights it, instead of showing a pop-up that made you guess.
The "on track" line on the Next Target card no longer wraps onto a second line, and now uses the same short date style as your Freedom Date.
Fixed the Freedom Date card reading "1 months away" in your final month.
The floating button no longer sits on top of the last section at the bottom of the page.
